reviews.title: Exploitive Game
reviews.text: I fell out of love with this game. As someone who loves the walking dead, I gave this game a chance. For a year, I made content on it but fell out of love. There’s so many new features that help you fight stronger enemies but doesn’t impact gameplay. There’s been a major content and hero drought, and when there are new heroes, it’s an adaptation of one already in the game. Where’s Andrea, Dale, and Lori? On top of this, there are so many micro transactions in the game shoved in your face, and a lot of them are imperative for keeping up with the meta that it’s insane. It’s as if this game was designed solely to drain your bank account and take advantage of you. Even if you’re tired of buying, you keep doing it, because if you stop, and quit playing, your weapons will be outdated and you’d have wasted that money. To make the game interesting, there should be weapon buffs, instead of having to purchase new ones, less new purchases, more heroes, and an updated story mode. This game has a lot of potential, but will eventually lose its entire player base at the pace it’s going.

reviews.title: Garbage Support Team
reviews.text: I used to play this game religiously back in 2021 and had a blast doing so. I eventually got a new phone and just never remembered to reinstall the game. I had a bunch of stuff in my original account and I even spent money on the game. When I came back in 2026 everything was gone. When I tried to get support to help me they were pretty useless in doing so and just kept coming up with excuses instead of doing something to fix it. I provided a ton of evidence and information to try and recover that account but to no avail. I can’t fathom just how terribly they handled the situation and didn’t do much to try and help. Save yourself and don’t spend money on this game and don’t invest too much time into it.

reviews.title: Crashes and Privacy Invasion
reviews.text: Came back after years away from this game. So. Many. Crashes. My IOS is up to date. Didn’t matter. Game stuttered and sputtered until eventual crash. After my 6th or 7th crash I just uninstalled. Additionally, the extra “we need to track your app activity” and all the pop up screens telling me to accept these terms and those terms. What the hell? You shouldn’t need that much data from any consumer to run a game. Not worth it.

reviews.title: Not What It Used to Be
reviews.text: I used to really love this game. These days, it seems like the people who are creating content are focused on how to make it so that people spend the vacuuming about of money to keep up or stay ahead. I like the guild wars. I like belonging to a guild and communicating with them. That’s fun. But I miss the courses and levels that come with being new to the game. Those were REALLY fun. I’ve beaten them on all 3 difficulty levels, and now I’m stuck with only guild wars and the endless repetitive challenges that offer very MEH prizes. I don’t it’s going to be too long until I leave this game.
